remarks: Bright & Spacious Stamford Condo! Discover this newly renovated condo in a prime Stamford location, just minutes from the train station, Harbor Point, Stamford Town Center, and top-rated restaurants. This sunny and spacious unit features gleaming hardwood floors throughout, a modern kitchen with brand-new stainless steel appliances, and an open living and dining area-perfect for entertaining, as well as that much needed office work space. You'll also love the beautiful new full bathroom. Enjoy ample closet space, on-site laundry, and the added bonus of heat, gas and hot water included in common charges. Move-in ready and not to be missed! Parking: Bank lot behind building available Monday-Friday 4:30pm to 7:30am, all weekend & bank holidays. PLUS local permit parking available - more info to follow.
